turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I have started drinking two glasses of wine every evening to switch my head off.
How did that feel for you?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while. I keep coming back to it.
Mm-hm. Go on.
My girlfriend Claire has been very patient, she makes me tea and does not push me to talk.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts. It is not easy to talk about.
Mm-hm. Go on.
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today.
Take your time.
On Tuesday I had a panic attack on the train to Manchester, my hands went numb and I had to get off at Stalybridge.
Take your time.
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. I keep coming back to it.
What went through your mind then?
Dad has another neurology appointment in Leeds next week and I have to take the day off again.
Tell me more about that.
I had a long day yesterday and I was so tired in the evening that I just sat in front of the television. That is how it was.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
Thank you, see you next week.

facts.heading: Panic attack on the train
